children: Paylocity entered into an amended and restated senior secured revolving credit facility to bolster liquidity for working capital, investments, and share repurchases. The $1.75 billion facility, led by PNC Bank with other lenders, matures on September 17, 2031 and includes $175 million swingline and $175 million letter of credit sublimits. Borrowings accrue interest at Term SOFR or an adjusted base rate plus a margin tied to leverage, and the company may upsize commitments by up to $875 million and request up to two one-year extensions. As of signing, $81.25 million was outstanding.
: Senior secured five-year revolving credit facility (amended and restated)
: PNC Bank, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Enhance liquidity for working capital and acquisitions
